references.text: David calls out to God in distress, and God calms the storm to a whisper, similar to how Jesus calms the storm.
The prophecy that God will come to save and that the sea will listen to him, as a foreshadowing of Jesus' power over nature.
Peter begins to sink while walking on water toward Jesus, and Jesus rebukes his little faith, paralleling his comment about the disciples' little faith in the storm.
A parallel event where Jesus calms a storm and the disciples wonder who he is, demonstrating his divine power.
A similar event where Jesus calms a storm and questions the disciples' faith, showing his control over nature.
